title_hi: मिरर गेम! नटखट चिंटू और मिठू
description: Chintu the baby elephant and Mithu the parrot play a fun mirror game for toddlers. Learn to copy moves and dance along with Rangeela Rhymes! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon #Preschool
learning: Imitation and motor skill development through interactive mirror play.

scenes.text: अरे! ये आइना किसका है, who is standing here?
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, cute 3D Chintu the orange elephant standing in front of a shiny magical mirror in a colorful playroom, sparkly eyes, high quality CGI.

scenes.text: Chintu raises his trunk, up and down, wave wave!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu the orange elephant with a blue scarf waving his trunk happily, bright sunny nursery background, 3D style.

scenes.text: मिठू ने भी पंख हिलाए, flap flap flap!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Mithu the tiny green parrot with a red cap flapping wings excitedly, close up, vibrant colors, 3D CGI.

scenes.text: Now jump, jump, jump, chhota sa hop!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu jumping together in the air, joyous expressions, dynamic motion blur, bright playroom setting.

scenes.text: हाथ घुमाओ, गोल गोल, spin spin spin!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu spinning around with his trunk curled, motion lines, high energy, preschool CGI style.

scenes.text: Big wide smile, giggle and clap, clap, clap!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, close up on Chintu and Mithu laughing and clapping, eyes full of wonder, soft lighting, 3D character design.

scenes.text: Wah! Hum toh bilkul match karte hain!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu hugging each other happily, celebratory atmosphere, confetti background, 3D render.

scenes.text: Ruko! Mirror game phir se shuru karte hain!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu pointing his trunk at the camera playfully, transition blur effect, bright and inviting.
